issues.problem: Implementation gets 3 weeks against 13-20 sized: migration rehearsal, testing and training in week 10, three cutovers plus stabilization in weeks 11-12. Criterion 2 cannot be shown.
issues.fix: Size Implementation on its counted 13-20 weeks and note the week criterion 2 can first show, for the partner to confirm against the 29 January board date.

issues.problem: Implementation moves the first company onto Grupo Vale's systems in weeks 10-12, before the board approves the plan. Gate G5 approves after cutover, leaving nothing to decide.
issues.fix: Sequence the board's approval of the plan before first-company cutover; set the final gate's decision on what the cutover result means for moving the other two companies.

issues.problem: Design gets 3 weeks against 5-9 sized: three company designs, then the board plan with sequence, risks and stakeholder review in one week (W5).
issues.fix: Size Design at no less than its 5-week minimum and give the plan review its own sign-off week; recover the weeks from Implementation, not from the board plan.

issues.problem: G4 decides go/no-go on cutover in week 9 from D4 and D5 only; the readiness record D6 arrives in week 10 and is reviewed at G5, after cutover.
issues.fix: Add a go-live meeting after D6 and before W7 starts, presenting D6 for the cutover decision; keep G5 to reviewing the cutover result and what it means for the plan.

issues.problem: W8 updates the integration plan "with cutover results" in weeks 11-12 but follows nothing, running alongside W7, whose results arrive only at its end; its plan review repeats W5's.
issues.fix: Set W8 to follow W7 so cutover results exist before the plan update, or drop it and fold the cutover findings into W7's confirmation.
